lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak j guramukh karahi so paravaan hai jo naam rahe liv laai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, whatever the Gurmukhs do is acceptable; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਕੰਉ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau balihaaree ti(n)n ka(n)u jo guramukh sikhaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those Sikhs who are Gurmukhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har naam dhiaaide tin darasan pikhaa ||
lines.translation: I behold the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of those who meditate on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਲਿਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun keeratan har gun ravaa har jas man likhaa ||
lines.translation: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, I contemplate His virtues; I write His Praises on the fabric of my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕ੍ਰਿਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam salaahee ra(n)g siu sabh kilavikh krikhaa ||
lines.translation: I praise the Lord's Name with love, and eradicate all my sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸੋ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਰੇ ਵਿਖਾ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dha(n)n suhaavaa so sareer thaan hai jithai meraa gur dhare vikhaa ||19||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed and beauteous is that body and place, where my Guru places His feet. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin giaan na hovaee naa sukh vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained, and peace does not come to abide in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vihoone manamukhee jaasan janam gavaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the self-willed manmukhs depart, after having wasted their lives. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਥਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidh saadhik naavai no sabh khojade thak rahe liv laai ||
lines.translation: All the Siddhas, spiritual masters and seekers search for the Name; they have grown weary of concentrating and focusing their attention.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaio guramukh milai milaai ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name; the Gurmukhs unite in Union with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਧਿਗੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਧਿਗੁ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai painan khaan sabh baad hai dhig sidhee dhig karamaat ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, all food and clothes are worthless; cursed is such spirituality, and cursed are such miraculous powers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa sidh saa karamaat hai achi(n)t kare jis daat ||
lines.translation: That alone is spirituality, and that alone is miraculous power, which the Carefree Lord spontaneously bestows.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਹਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh har naam man vasai ehaa sidh ehaa karamaat ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's Name abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; this is spirituality, and this is miraculous power. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਢਾਢੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਸਮ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਛੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham dhaadhee har prabh khasam ke nit gaavah har gun chha(n)taa ||
lines.translation: I am a minstrel of God, my Lord and Master; every day, I sing the songs of the Lord's Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਹ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਵਲਾ ਕੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har keeratan karah har jas sunah tis kavalaa ka(n)taa ||
lines.translation: I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and I listen to the Praises of the Lord, the Master of wealth and Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਿਖਾਰੀਆ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har daataa sabh jagat bhikhaareeaa ma(n)gat jan ja(n)taa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Great Giver; all the world is begging; all beings and creatures are beggars.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har devahu daan daiaal hoi vich paathar krim ja(n)taa ||
lines.translation: O Lord, You are kind and compassionate; You give Your gifts to even worms and insects among the rocks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa guramukh dhanava(n)taa ||20||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he has become truly wealthy. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਣਾ ਗੁੜਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: paRanaa guRanaa sa(n)saar kee kaar hai a(n)dar trisanaa vikaar ||
lines.translation: Reading and studying are just worldly pursuits, if there is thirst and corruption within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai vich sabh paR thake doojai bhaai khuaar ||
lines.translation: Reading in egotism, all have grown weary; through the love of duality, they are ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: so paRiaa so pa(n)dit beenaa gur sabad kare veechaar ||
lines.translation: He alone is educated, and he alone is a wise Pandit, who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੈ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar khojai tat lahai paae mokh duaar ||
lines.translation: He searches within himself, and finds the true essence; he finds the Door of Salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun nidhaan har paaiaa sahaj kare veechaar ||
lines.translation: He finds the Lord, the treasure of excellence, and peacefully contemplates Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n vaapaaree naanakaa jis guramukh naam adhaar ||1||
lines.translation: Blessed is the trader, O Nanak, who, as Gurmukh, takes the Name as his only Support. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਿਝਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin man maare koi na sijhaee vekhahu ko liv laai ||
lines.translation: Without conquering his mind, no one can be successful. See this, and concentrate on it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਤੀਰਥੀ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhekhadhaaree teerathee bhav thake naa ehu man maariaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The wandering holy men are tired of of making pilgrimages to sacred shrines; they have not been able to conquer their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh ehu man jeevat marai sach rahai liv laai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh has conquered his mind, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਇਉ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak is man kee mal iu utarai haumai sabad jalaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, this is how the filth of the mind is removed; the Word of the Shabad burns away the ego. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹੁ ਇਕ ਕਿਨਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har sa(n)t milahu mere bhaaee har naam driRaavahu ik kinakaa ||
lines.translation: O Saints of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny, please meet with me, and implant the Name of the One Lord within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਹੁ ਖਿਮ ਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har seegaar banaavahu har jan har kaapaR pahirahu khim kaa ||
lines.translation: O humble servants of the Lord, adorn me with the decorations of the Lord, Har, Har; let me wear the robes of the Lord's forgiveness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਮ ਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa seegaar mere prabh bhaavai har laagai piaaraa prim kaa ||
lines.translation: Such decorations are pleasing to my God; such love is dear to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਇਕ ਪਲਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam bolahu din raatee sabh kilabikh kaatai ik palakaa ||
lines.translation: I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night; in an instant, all sins are eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਿਣਕਾ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har daiaal hovai jis upar so guramukh har jap jinakaa ||21||
lines.translation: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord becomes merciful, chants the Lord's Name, and wins the game of life. ||21||
